question: Can you tell us the name of the frog that sits on top of Usopp's head as well as how they met? and Takshi
answer: His name is Gama Pyonnosuke. Usopp happened to be passing by one day while he was staring down a dangerous snake so he jumped on Usopp's head as a ride away from the situation. Usopp is scared of snakes so he ferociously dashed away. Pyonnosuke realized afterwards that staying with Usopp seemed like a safe option so he just never got off.
name: Macchi and Takshi
